figs.name: transformer-efficiency-calculation-steps-flowchart
figs.alt: transformer efficiency calculation flowchart with the 100 kVA half load example
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog walking the article formula through five steps for the 100 kVA unit at half load, giving 95.92 percent, with the 77.5 percent maximum efficiency point.
figs.after_h2: The 3 Transformer Efficiency Formulas You Need
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart for calculating transformer efficiency at any load</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#064e3b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Transformer Efficiency in 5 Steps</text>
<rect x="150" y="58" width="400" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350.0" y="87.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1  Read test certificate</text>
<text x="350.0" y="111.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">P_iron 1.2 kW, P_cu_FL 2.0 kW</text>
<line x1="350" y1="128" x2="350" y2="146" stroke="#064e3b" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="150" y="146" width="400" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350.0" y="175.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2  Set load fraction x</text>
<text x="350.0" y="199.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">x = 0.5 for half load</text>
<line x1="350" y1="216" x2="350" y2="234" stroke="#064e3b" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="150" y="234" width="400" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350.0" y="263.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3  P_out = x × kVA × pf</text>
<text x="350.0" y="287.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.5 × 100 × 0.8 = 40 kW</text>
<line x1="350" y1="304" x2="350" y2="322" stroke="#064e3b" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="150" y="322" width="400" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350.0" y="351.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4  P_cu = x² × P_cu_FL</text>
<text x="350.0" y="375.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.25 × 2000 = 500 W</text>
<line x1="350" y1="392" x2="350" y2="410" stroke="#064e3b" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="150" y="410" width="400" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="350.0" y="439.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5  η = P_out ÷ (P_out + losses)</text>
<text x="350.0" y="463.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">40,000 ÷ 41,700 = 95.92 %</text>
<rect x="590" y="190" width="190" height="210" rx="10" fill="#059669" stroke="#064e3b" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="685.0" y="254.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Best load</text>
<text x="685.0" y="277.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">x_max = √(1.2 ÷ 2.0)</text>
<text x="685.0" y="300.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">= 0.7746</text>
<text x="685.0" y="323.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">η_max</text>
<text x="685.0" y="346.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">96.27 %</text>
<line x1="552" y1="300" x2="588" y2="300" stroke="#064e3b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="520" font-size="18" fill="#064e3b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Full load gives 96.15 %, half load 95.92 %</text>
<text x="400" y="552" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Peak efficiency comes where copper loss equals iron loss</text>
</svg>

figs.name: transformer-efficiency-all-day-infographic
figs.alt: transformer efficiency all day example: 880 kWh output, 45.8 kWh loss, 95.05 percent
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog laying out the 24 hour load cycle from the article: 6 h full, 10 h half and 8 h no load give 880 kWh out, 45.8 kWh lost and 95.05 percent.
figs.after_h2: All-Day Efficiency Calculation for the Same 100 kVA Transformer

<text x="371.66666666666663" y="220" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">17.0 kWh loss</text>
<rect x="513.3" y="90" width="226.7" height="70" fill="#94a3b8" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="626.6666666666666" y="132" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No load, 8 h</text>
<text x="626.6666666666666" y="192" font-size="18" fill="#064e3b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0 kW out</text>
<text x="626.6666666666666" y="220" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">9.6 kWh loss</text>
<text x="60" y="80" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">0 h</text>
<text x="740" y="80" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">24 h</text>
<rect x="30" y="260" width="236" height="160" rx="14" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="148" y="316" font-size="30" fill="#064e3b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">880 kWh</text>
<text x="148" y="352" font-size="18" fill="#064e3b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">output</text>
<text x="148" y="388" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">480 + 400 + 0</text>
<rect x="282" y="260" width="236" height="160" rx="14" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="316" font-size="30" fill="#064e3b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">45.8 kWh</text>
<text x="400" y="352" font-size="18" fill="#064e3b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">losses</text>
<text x="400" y="388" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">19.2 + 17.0 + 9.6</text>
<rect x="534" y="260" width="236" height="160" rx="14" fill="#064e3b" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="652" y="316" font-size="30" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">95.05 %</text>
<text x="652" y="352" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">all day efficiency</text>
<text x="652" y="388" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">880 ÷ 925.8</text>
<text x="400" y="470" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Iron loss runs all 24 hours, even with no load connected,</text>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">so all day efficiency is lower than the full load 96.15 %</text>
</svg>
